request: Planet and starfield missing behind the Federation fleet (gunship approach) and space missing from G.F.S. Olympus windows
diagnosis: F7 draw dump (frame 7662): draws 0-22 are the sky layers (512x512 textures, rotation-only view matrix, XF viewport sz=0, depth compare LEQUAL, no depth write); they were submitted but did not appear.
User-run experiment A (no depth test for collapsed-range draws) made the planet and stars appear, so the depth test rejected them; experiment B (far plane moved out) was not needed.

Full-precision dump: Prime's XF viewport uses oz=16777216, one past the 24-bit EFB maximum 0xFFFFFF. Hardware saturates to 0xFFFFFF (equal to the 0xFFFFFF clear) and LEQUAL passes; Aurora converted it to exactly 1.0, which under reversed-Z lands just beyond the cleared depth (16777215/16777216) and fails GreaterEqual.
fix: aurora-main/lib/gx/command_processor.cpp: logical viewport znear/zfar from XF are clamped to 16777215/16777216 like the hardware saturation. Non-collapsed ranges change by at most one 24-bit unit at the far end.
